method.sampling: Six records in each of four prespecified strata: verified single-master clean turns; own-record addressee/visitor/anonymous turns; anthology/header turns; preface/contributor and embedded-quotation turns.
method.evidence: attribution_packet.py output plus adjudication of the complete source unit surrounding each stored KWIC. When the packet unit did not contain its own KWIC, the normalized source was widened around the exact KWIC before adjudication.
method.falseAccept: A Tier A candidate whose proposed title owner is not the exact speaker of the headword-bearing turn.
method.falseReject: A B-review result where the complete source unit establishes that the title owner is the exact speaker and title-first acceptance would have been correct.
method.acceptanceCriterion: Tier A must have zero false accepts.

summary.verdict: FAIL: the proposed Tier A rule is not safe.

records.wholeUnitFinding: The verse containing 蟭螟吞却金翅鳥 is Baiyun Shouduan's own answer in 白雲守端禪師廣錄; no embedded speaker supersedes him.
In Hongzhi's own recorded ascent to the hall, the continuing 師/上堂 voice says 木人招手; the generic citation and contributor flags are false alarms.
The unit is an 上堂 in 無異元來禪師廣錄 and Wuyi himself concludes 木人起舞非奇特; it is not contributor prose.
The headword line is delivered by Duanqiao in his own record; an anonymous question elsewhere in the broad unit does not transfer the line's speaker.
The exact 上堂 line 諸和尚子 is Xuefeng's direct address in 雪峰義存禪師語錄; the packet's broad unit starts in a preceding embedded exchange but the exact turn is clean.
The unit explicitly opens 汝洪監寺請上堂，師拈拄杖云 and the first-person 老僧 sentence with 羊腸鳥道 is Weilin's.
The biography says Huangbo Rong presented the headword-bearing question to Baichi and Rong then approved the response; a nearby Huangbo header is not the questioner's identity.
Under 太史山谷居士黃庭堅, 公 speaks 和尚得恁麼老婆心切 to Huitang; the addressee is not the speaker.
In Zhaozhou's own record, 師 says 謝和尚指示 to Nanquan. The title owner is the speaker, while Nanquan is the addressee.
The record owner summons Fayun, hands him the whisk, and 雲接拂子曰 introduces Fayun's exact headword-bearing turn.
An anonymous interlocutor asks about the original face; 山 supplies the headword-bearing answer 不行鳥道 under Dongshan's section. Header plus turn resolution, not title, identifies the speaker.
In Bodhidharma's section, 神光/光 (Huike) says 惟願和尚慈悲 to Bodhidharma. The section owner is the addressee, not the exact speaker.

The anthology's local sequence attributes the verse ending 八花磚上輥金毬 to Cishou. The packet caseText incorrectly begins in the collection preface and does not contain the KWIC, so this can never be Tier A without boundary repair.
The line 木人方歌，石女起舞 belongs to Dongshan's material under 瑞州洞山良价悟本禪師; the anthology title cannot name him.
The normalized source explicitly opens 蘇州西山和尚 before 師舉拂子. The nearest broad lineage header points to Nanquan and is not the local speaker header.
Within Yantou's section, 師云 introduces 德山老漢只憑目前一個白棒. Deshan is the person discussed; Yantou is the exact speaker.
The headword occurs in Hongzhi's own portrait-praise sequence in 宏智禪師廣錄. Nothing in the exact poem transfers the voice to another master.
Huanglong introduces and comments on the cited story with 舉五祖戒和尚 in his own sermon. The local header is a place-section label (黃蘗山法語), not Huangbo Xiyun speaking.
The sentence 一棒一痕要令證悟 is in 碧巖錄序 signed 三教老人, Zhou Chi. Yuanwu is the work's master, not the preface speaker.
The headword-bearing life account/stupa prose is by contributor Cao Benrong; neither the record's subject nor the parser's generic 國師 alias is the prose speaker.
The five-part 休去歇去…寒灰枯木去 formula is an embedded inherited saying of Shishuang, not the anthology compiler or surrounding record owner.
Wufeng's autobiographical 行實 repeatedly marks Miyun as 本師; 本師握拂子云 introduces Miyun's quoted test. The book owner is the recorder/disciple, not the embedded speaker.

The widened exact unit reads 古德云 immediately before the verse containing 假銀. Xueguan quotes it but does not claim authorship; the present MasterName is therefore wrong even though the shortcut correctly withholds Tier A.

The exact line begins 應庵祖云, unambiguously naming Yingan. The title is 雪竇石奇禪師語錄: the parser mistakes the toponym 雪竇 for Xuedou Chongxian and ignores the actual record owner Shiqi Tongyun. This is a Tier A false accept with no emitted risk flag.

ruleGaps.gap: Bare place/monastery aliases are accepted as title-owner names.
ruleGaps.evidence: 雪竇 in 雪竇石奇禪師語錄 was resolved as Xuedou Chongxian although 石奇 identifies Shiqi Tongyun and the exact line explicitly says 應庵祖云.
ruleGaps.requiredRule: Title parsing must prefer the longest/full personal designation and must not treat a bare toponym or monastery name as a person when another named owner is present.

ruleGaps.gap: Explicit inline speaker markers do not veto Tier A.
ruleGaps.evidence: 應庵祖云 produced no risk flag; 古德云 also requires a widened unit to avoid assigning the quoter.
ruleGaps.requiredRule: Before Tier A, scan the exact headword-bearing turn and its introducing clause for X云, X曰, X道, 祖云, 古德云, 頌曰, 序 signatures, and role labels. A non-owner marker must override or force review.

ruleGaps.gap: Packet case boundaries are not guaranteed to contain the stored KWIC.
ruleGaps.evidence: The packet units for Cishou's 金毬 and several anthology cases began in unrelated preface or neighboring material and omitted the KWIC entirely.
ruleGaps.requiredRule: A Tier A packet must prove normalized(caseText) contains normalized(storedKwic). Otherwise rebuild/widen the unit and force review.

ruleGaps.gap: Generic risk flags over-reject clean owner speech.
ruleGaps.evidence: Eight B-review cases were exact title-owner speech after whole-unit inspection, including Hongzhi, Wuyi, Duanqiao, Xuefeng, Weilin, Zhaozhou, Hongzhi's portrait verse, and Huanglong.
ruleGaps.requiredRule: Compute risks on the exact headword-bearing turn, not the entire coarse unit or document. Contributor material elsewhere and anonymous interlocutors in neighboring turns must not taint a clean owner turn.

ruleGaps.gap: Title and broad-header ownership cannot resolve addressee, visitor, or embedded-speaker turns.
ruleGaps.evidence: Huike addresses Bodhidharma; Huang Tingjian addresses Huitang; Fayun answers the record owner; Miyun is quoted inside Wufeng's record; Xishan sits beneath a broad Nanquan lineage header.
ruleGaps.requiredRule: Tier A requires exact-turn role resolution. The grammatical speaker of the headword-bearing clause must match the candidate; addressee, subject, quoter, quoted speaker, section owner, and contributor are distinct roles.
